raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

Backport merged PR #6624 to `r0.7.0`.

## What changed

- Upgrade system PyNvVideoCodec to `2.2.3` without resolving dependencies for the bundled FFmpeg remediation.
- Explicitly remove `opencv-python-headless` from both virtualenv and system Python, retaining system DALI removal.
- Update the container documentation.

## Details

Cherry-picked landed squash commit `3e488cdbc44b1050239623b10f1874e7c8cf017c` with `-x`, without conflicts. The backport is signed and signed off by `svcnemo-autobot` and has an identical stable patch ID to the source.

## Tested

Verified commit signature, source patch equivalence, clean working tree, `git diff --check`, and exact fork remote head. Repository tests and container builds were not run; validation is delegated to PR CI.

detail.title: cp: backport FFmpeg security fixes to r0.7.0

files.patch:
@@ -97,7 +97,6 @@ RUN \
 ##
 ##############################################################################
 
-# PyNvVideoCodec 2.0.5 replaces the base image's vulnerable FFmpeg 8.1.1 libraries.
 RUN pip install "fastapi==0.139.1" \
     "starlette==1.3.1" \
     "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=8.0.0" \
@@ -117,10 +116,16 @@ RUN pip install "fastapi==0.139.1" \
     "jupyterlab>=4.5.10" \
     "jupyter-server>=2.20.0" \
     "mistune>=3.3.0" \
-    "pynvvideocodec==2.0.5" \
     "GitPython>=3.1.62,<4" && \
-    # Address CVE from transitive dependency
-    pip uninstall -y opencv-python-headless nvidia-dali-cuda130
+    # pip targets system Python; explicitly remove the virtualenv copy too.
+    uv pip uninstall --python /opt/venv/bin/python opencv-python-headless && \
+    uv pip uninstall --python /usr/bin/python3 --system --break-system-packages \
+        opencv-python-headless nvidia-dali-cuda130
+
+# FFmpeg 9.0.1 fixes CVE-2026-65703, CVE-2026-64835, and CVE-2026-64834.
+# Upgrade the system installation that owns the bundled libraries without resolving dependencies.
+RUN uv pip install --python /usr/bin/python3 --system --break-system-packages --no-deps \
+    "pynvvideocodec==2.2.3"
 
 # Remove PyTorch's bundled third-party onnx source tree (build artifact, not used at runtime).
 # The actual onnx Python package is managed above via pip/uv; this stale copy triggers CVE scanners.

@@ -121,7 +121,7 @@ Starting with the 26.04 (r0.4.0) release, the following Python packages are **no
 |---------|---------------------|
 | [`av`](https://pypi.org/project/av/) (PyAV) | Vendored FFmpeg binaries carried an unfixed CVE. |
 | [`decord`](https://pypi.org/project/decord/) | Unmaintained; vendored FFmpeg binaries carried an unfixed CVE. |
-| [`opencv-python-headless`](https://pypi.org/project/opencv-python-headless/) | Bundled native libs carried an unfixed CVE. The Dockerfile also explicitly runs `pip uninstall -y opencv-python-headless` after the base-container install to scrub any pre-existing copy. |
+| [`opencv-python-headless`](https://pypi.org/project/opencv-python-headless/) | Bundled FFmpeg libraries carry CVEs. The final Dockerfile explicitly uninstalls this package from both `/opt/venv` and system Python; system `pip` alone leaves the virtualenv copy installed. |
 
 These packages are suppressed via `sys_platform == 'never'` overrides in `/opt/Megatron-Bridge/pyproject.toml` (for `av`) and `/opt/NeMo-FW/pyproject.toml` (for all three). The override propagates to transitive consumers such as `qwen-vl-utils` and `decord[av-decode]`, so `uv sync` and `uv pip install <pkg>` will silently skip them.
